workflow.critical: Execute ALL steps in exact order

check.ask: Please provide the path to the user story file:

step.goal: Load and read the story file completely
step.action: Identify and store internally: title, actor, goal, benefit, acceptance criteria (exact list), technical notes
Count and store {ac_count} = number of acceptance criteria found in the story file
The skill emits a structured JSON AST saved to reports/story-asts/{story_id}.json

step.output:
**Story Analysis Complete for: {story_id}**
Display the following sections from the AST: 1. Acceptance Criteria (numbered list) 2. Positive Scenarios 3. Negative Scenarios 4. Edge Cases 5. Security Scenarios 6. Risks and Dependencies 7. Data Needed

step.goal: Self-review — verify artifact completeness and accuracy

artifact-checklist.file: Story AST — must exist and be valid JSON

quality-checklist.check: Story AST JSON file exists and is valid parseable JSON
AST contains an acceptance_criteria array with exactly {ac_count} items — one entry per AC found in the original story file. No AC may be omitted.
Each acceptance criterion in the AST matches the original text in {story_file} — no paraphrasing that loses meaning
At least 2 positive test scenarios are defined
At least 1 negative test scenario is defined per acceptance criterion
Edge cases section is not empty — contains boundary conditions, empty input, max-length, special characters
Security scenarios section covers at minimum: unauthorised access attempt and input injection
Risks and Dependencies section is populated
Data Needed section lists concrete test data values (not vague placeholders)

review.fix-if-needed: For every failed check, apply the specific fix before marking this step complete: - SA-2/SA-3 → re-read {story_file}, extract every AC precisely, update the AST - SA-4 → add missing positive scenarios covering happy-path and alternate flows - SA-5 → add negative scenarios for each AC (invalid input, missing required field, auth failure, etc.) - SA-6 → add edge cases: empty inputs, boundary values, maximum length, special characters, concurrent actions - SA-7 → add security scenarios: SQL injection attempt, XSS payload, CSRF, broken auth - SA-8/SA-9 → populate with specific values based on the story context After all fixes, save the corrected AST to the JSON file and re-display the updated analysis.

step.output: ✅ Review complete — story AST verified: {ac_count} ACs captured, all scenario sections populated
step.ask: Would you like to proceed with test case generation for this story? [Y/N]

check.output: ✅ Analysis saved. Run [FW] Full Workflow or [GE] Generate E2E Tests to continue.
